dedupe_keys.name: harmonised database on materials energy flows and environmental impacts for building archetypes representing the eu27 building stock

description: Harmonised database on materials, energy flows and environmental impacts for building archetypes representing the EU27 building stock. is a data set deposited in KU Leuven RDR by its authors Delphine Ramon, Giulia Pristerà (Associatie KU Leuven). This dataset provides per EU country 1) a detailed life cycle inventory (LCI), and 2) a life cycle impact assessment (LCIA) of both existing and newly constructed building archetypes representing the EU27 building stock. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1935850. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
